lines.text: Лежачи на животі. Ляжте на живіт, витягніть обидві ноги в колінах і залиштеся так. 10 хвилин, 2 рази на день.
lines.source_en: Lying face down. Lie on your stomach with both hips straight and stay there. 10 minutes, 2 times a day.
lines.back_translation: Lying on the stomach. Lie on your stomach, extend both legs at the knees and remain like this. 10 minutes, 2 times a day.

lines.text: Місток на одній нозі (права). Ляжте на спину, зігніть праве коліно, а іншу ногу витягніть, підніміть таз над ліжком. 3 × 10, щодня.
lines.source_en: Single-leg bridge (right). Lie on your back with your right knee bent and the other leg straight, and lift your hips off the bed. 3 × 10, every day.
lines.back_translation: Bridge on one leg (right). Lie on your back, bend your right knee, and extend the other leg, lift the pelvis above the bed. 3 × 10, every day.

lines.text: Підйом ноги на боці (ліва). Ляжте на бік і підніміть верхню ногу прямо вгору, потім повільно опустіть її. 3 × 12, щодня.
lines.source_en: Side-lying leg lift (left). Lie on your side and lift the upper leg straight up, then lower it slowly. 3 × 12, every day.
lines.back_translation: Leg lift on the side (left). Lie on your side and lift the upper leg straight up, then slowly lower it. 3 x 12, every day.

lines.text: Випрямлення коліна сидячи з еспандером (ліва). Сядьте на стілець, обмотайте еспандером навколо щиколотки і повільно випрямляйте коліно. 3 × 12, щодня.
lines.source_en: Seated knee straightening with a band (left). Sit on a chair with the band around the ankle and straighten the knee slowly. 3 × 12, every day.
lines.back_translation: Knee straightening while sitting with an expander (left). Sit on a chair, wrap the expander around the ankle, and slowly straighten the knee. 3 x 12, every day.

lines.text: Стійка на одній нозі (ліва). Станьте на одну ногу поруч зі стійкою, за яку можна вчепитися, і утримуйте положення. 3 × 30 секунд, щодня, вдома. Станьте поруч із кухонною стійкою. З ваших записів: Перевіряйте шкіру кульшової частини після носіння протеза.
lines.source_en: Single-leg stance (left). Stand on one leg next to a counter you can grab, and hold the position. 3 × 30 seconds, every day, at home. Stand next to the kitchen counter. From your records: Check the skin of the residual limb after wearing the prosthesis.
lines.back_translation: Standing on one leg (left). Stand on one leg next to a support that you can hold onto, and maintain the position. 3 x 30 seconds, daily, at home. Stand next to the kitchen counter. From your records: Check the skin of the hip joint after wearing the prosthesis.

objections.detail: R04: documented restriction found, therapist decides. Standing on the left prosthesis alone only in supervised sessions until the prosthetist clears it.

1. **Side:** The Ukrainian uses 'ліва' (left) which is correctly translated as 'left' in the back-translation. The original uses '(left)' which is a parenthetical note. 2. **Support:** The Ukrainian uses 'стійкою' which literally translates to 'support' or 'stand', but in context refers to a counter. The original uses 'counter'. 3. **Hip Joint:** The Ukrainian uses 'кульшової частини' which translates to 'hip joint'. The original uses 'residual limb'. 4. **Frequency:** The Ukrainian uses 'щодня'

raised.detail: R04: documented restriction found, therapist decides. Standing on the left prosthesis alone only in supervised sessions until the prosthetist clears it.
The original specifies 'left' leg, while the back-translation specifies 'right' leg. This is a significant difference in the side of the body being targeted.
The original specifies 'ankle', while the back-translation specifies 'lower leg'. This is a significant difference in the location of the band placement.

The original specifies 'residual limb', while the back-translation specifies 'hip part'. This is a significant difference in the body part to be checked. The original also includes the instruction to check 'after wearing the prosthesis', which is omitted in the back-translation.

The Ukrainian back-translation refers to 'hip part' instead of 'residual limb'. The Ukrainian back-translation does not specify that the counter is for support.
